audits.general_notes: The location requires significant improvement in process adherence, documentation, and operational discipline. Multiple gaps were observed in Job Card quality, record maintenance, and compliance with standard guidelines. Staff awareness of processes is limited, and several explanations provided during the audit were unsupported and unacceptable. Regular monitoring, structured training, and stronger managerial supervision are required to ensure sustained compliance.
